title: May Explain Tutor-Layer Implementation Results

newFunctions.name: _buildTutorExplanation(question)
newFunctions.purpose: Builds a structured tutor-layer explanation object from question data

returns.shortAnswer: string — concise answer in May's voice
returns.patternRecognition: string — how to recognize this pattern next time
returns.reviewFocus: string — what to review if missed
returns.sourceExplanationIncluded: boolean — whether bank ExplanationCorrect is embedded

newFunctions.name: _interpretExplanation(explanation, topic, isCalculation)
newFunctions.purpose: Extracts a plain-language key sentence from the bank explanation

newFunctions.name: _inferCommonTrap(q, topic, isCalculation)
newFunctions.purpose: Infers a common trap from wrong-answer explanations or question type

newFunctions.name: _inferPatternRecognition(q, topic, section, isCalculation)
newFunctions.purpose: Suggests how to recognize this question pattern in the future

newFunctions.name: _inferReviewFocus(q, topic, section)
newFunctions.purpose: Recommends what to review if the learner missed this item

modifiedFunctions.name: _explainAnswer()
modifiedFunctions.change: Delegates to _buildTutorExplanation; assembles 6-section structured output instead of flat explanation-only output

modifiedFunctions.name: miniExplain()
modifiedFunctions.change: Uses _buildTutorExplanation for richer mini-explain with trap awareness

safetyPreserved._guardedSpeak: Still wraps explain output in pilot mode
safetyPreserved.antiFabrication: Thin-explanation fallback says 'bank explanation is brief, so I'll keep this grounded' — no invented ASC/FASB/COSO citations
safetyPreserved.answerLeakage: No changes to answer-gating — miniExplain still blocks before attempt
safetyPreserved.examMode: No changes — _explainAnswer unreachable during exam mode via handleAction gate
safetyPreserved.predictionLanguage: No pass/fail/exam-ready language in any tutor-layer output

note: All existing section-specific coaching (caseWhatMattered, caseApproachNote, topic progress) preserved alongside new tutor-layer sections.
